⭐ **Filed exactly as rule 3 requires** — 「已验收 PR 的产物流向另一仓,接受该 PR 的执行席立即在消费仓立后续单」 — by the skills seat, naming its source (objectstack#17040 → PR objectstack#17484, merged 2026-09-10T18:05Z, `33e07f7c`). ⇒ The cross-repo follow-up mechanism working as written, and worth saying so.

**`domain:devx`**: objectui routes the engineering surface there, and a merge-group guard is that surface. ⛔ Not `domain:skills` — objectui has no such stream, and the guard's subject here is the queue, not a governed surface.

⚠️ **Port, ⛔ do not re-derive.** The landed leg already solved the part that is easy to get wrong: **the queue head ref names only the LAST PR**, so keying on it under-enumerates — the objectstack leg enumerates every PR the group lands, per commit. ⇒ A fresh implementation that keys on the head ref will look right and silently miss PRs.

⚠️ Confirm objectui actually **has** the `needs:contract-review` label and a merge queue before building; a guard for a label nobody applies is a gate with no subject. ⛔ If either is absent, stop and report rather than creating them.

`priority:p3`: it closes a hole that has not been measured to have leaked in this repo — a guard, not a repair.

## Grading confirmed, then premises re-derived

`created_at` 2026-09-10T18:12:56Z vs `updated_at` 18:29:10Z — **16 minutes apart**, with a triage comment. ⇒ a real grading pass, not a self-applied label.

### ⭐ Triage's two preconditions, both MEASURED rather than assumed

> ⚠️ Confirm objectui actually **has** the `needs:contract-review` label and a merge queue before building; a guard for a label nobody applies is a gate with no subject. ⛔ If either is absent, stop and report rather than creating them.

| precondition | reading |
|:--|:--|
| the label **exists** | ✅ `GET /labels/needs:contract-review` → `id LA_kwDOQ40TZM8AAAACyH71rA`, colour `ededed` |
| the label is **applied** — the "no subject" half | ✅ **16** open items carry it right now (e.g. objectui#9108, objectui#9092, objectui#9091) ⇒ ⛔ not a gate with no subject |
| a **merge queue** exists | ✅ `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml` subscribes `merge_group:` at its line 42, and this seat has landed 36 PRs through that queue today — every one a single squash commit |

### The leg is genuinely absent

`needs:contract-review` appears **nowhere** in `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`. Its only occurrences under `scripts/` are in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, which declares `export const CONTRACT_REVIEW_LABEL = 'needs:contract-review';` for the PM half-state census — a different instrument entirely. ⇒ ⛔ the work is owed.

The guard's current exit vocabulary, read from the file:

```
EXIT_CLEAR = 0 · EXIT_CANNOT_RUN = 1 · EXIT_BAD_USAGE = 2
EXIT_REFUSED_UNAPPROVED = 3 · EXIT_REFUSED_UNREADABLE = 4 · EXIT_REFUSED_UNATTRIBUTED = 5
```

⇒ **6 and 7 are free**, which is what the objectstack leg uses.

## The deliverable

Port objectstack PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#17484's second `merge_group` leg into objectui's **native** guard:

- enumerate **every PR the group lands, per commit** — ⚠️ ⛔ **not** by keying on the queue head ref;
- read each PR's labels from the pull object (`pull-requests: read`, no new permission);
- **exit 6** while `needs:contract-review` is on any of them; **exit 7** when the label set cannot be read or the group names no PR;
- ⛔ leave the `pull_request` leg untouched — it reads no label.

## ⛔ Fences — binding

- ⚠️ ⛔ **PORT, do not re-derive** (triage, verbatim): *"the queue head ref names only the LAST PR, so keying on it under-enumerates. ⇒ A fresh implementation that keys on the head ref will look right and silently miss PRs."* Read the objectstack implementation **first**. ⭐ That sentence is the whole reason this is a port: the trap is invisible at review time and the wrong version passes every test you would think to write.
- ⛔ **This is a re-implementation, ⛔ not a sync.** objectui's guard is objectui-native by decision (objectui#6596 → PR objectui#6739) — deliberately **not** a pinned port, because the pin cannot express the deletion divergence. ⛔ Do not add it to `scripts/upstream-port-pin.json`.
- **The honest boundary carries over: the leg reads the LABEL, not the verdict.** Say so in the PR body; ⛔ do not quietly upgrade it into a verdict check.
- ⚠️ **State the current force in the PR body**: until the maintainer adds `Governed Surface Queue Guard` to objectui `main`'s ruleset required set (objectui#6596's still-open `Maintainer-action:` line), a refusal here is **a red check, not a blocked queue**. ⛔ Do not claim it blocks the queue.
- ⛔ **Do not create or apply the label**, and ⛔ do not touch the ruleset — both are out of this card's reach.
- ⛔ **Governed surface** (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`) out of scope. ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/`.
- ⛔ **Worktree-first**; ⛔ **never `git stash`** — `refs/stash` lives in the common `.git` dir and a `pop` takes another agent's entry while reporting **success**. ⚠️ `/home/user/objectui` is **shallow** and its working tree is ~580 commits stale; ⛔ do not cut your worktree from it — clone fresh into your own scratchpad.
- ⛔ Never skip/disable/weaken a test; never rebase/amend/force-push a pushed branch.
- ⛔ **Cleanup is gated on `git rev-parse HEAD` == `git ls-remote origin <branch>`**, ⛔ never on "the PR is open".

## Verification

- **The self-test is the acceptance surface.** objectstack's went 144 → 183 cases by replaying the **eleven measured enqueues of 2026-09-09** — six of them objectui's (objectui#8723, #8779, #8795, #8796, #8799, #8164). ⭐ objectui#8164 is *"the row that landed a real defect"*: it is the case that must **refuse**.
- ⭐ **A third leg proving ACCEPTANCE.** Two cases proving refusal leave the after-state reading as "a guard that now refuses everything". Add a group whose PRs carry **no** such label and show it **clear (exit 0)**, in the same run.
- Two-sided: exits **6** and **7** must each be reachable and reached for the right reason. Prove a mutation landed on disk before reading anything; restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`; prove the restore by blob equality **and** an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- Gates by required context with verdict lines quoted: `Test (shard N/4)`, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Control Byte Scan`. Exit codes by **redirect-then-capture**, ⛔ never through a pipe.
- ⚠️ **`pnpm lint` here is `turbo run lint` (per-package `eslint .`), ⛔ NOT `eslint . --no-inline-config`** — that flag reports 95 errors / 12,934 warnings on an untouched tree by stripping disable directives CI honours; ⛔ not a regression.
- ⛔ A grep line count is not an entity count — exclude comment lines (`grep -vE '^[^:]+:[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(\*|//|/\*)'`) and **print the matched lines**. ⭐ A raw count can read *unchanged* across a diff while the code-only count inverts; that happened on a card this seat landed an hour ago.
- ⛔ **A claim about what the code enforces is a claim, not a fence, until the enforcing line is quoted.** Everything in my premise table above is a reading of mine — redo it.

## Deliverable

A worktree, branch `claude/issue-9018-queue-guard-contract-review-leg`, commits, a push, a **draft** PR that `Fixes #9018`.

Commit messages end with:
```
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr
```
The PR description ends with:
```
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr
```

Report as `os-dev-report` JSON on this card with a `6_what_the_card_the_triage_and_the_pm_claim_got_wrong` section. ⭐ Every round today has corrected this seat on something, twice on a fence I wrote that named a mechanism that did not exist. Those corrections are the most valuable part of each report.

⛔ Out of scope ⇒ **file it bare** (no assignee, no `domain:*`, no `pm:*`) and name it in the report. ⛔ Do not fold it in.
